Audio exact SKU 32184 retains all 801 native source components; SKU 32185/EN omits only component 2 (battery) according to its NOT Included option. No native reset-button identity is asserted.
Audio full native Z extent 49.700000763 mm differs from photo callouts 43.7+5.1=48.8 mm. Geometry retained unscaled; stack scope, protrusions and CAD revision cannot be resolved without hardware.
